implementation.demo_institution_boundary: Hotel A and Hotel B exist only in guarded local/testing fixtures.
implementation.release_approval_identity_model: Named external reviewer and qualification are distinct from the authenticated Superadmin recorder.
implementation.identity_migration_preflight_default_dis: SHA-256 legacy-label groups and counts; no email addresses or plaintext legacy labels
implementation.invitation_transaction_boundary: Current actor role and membership are reloaded under institution-first locks; supersession and synchronous delivery failure are revoked and audited; a concurrent canonical-email collision rolls back to a bounded unavailable result.
implementation.invitation_cross_scope_id_contract: A real invitation UUID outside the actor's authorized institution scope returns the same not-found result as an unknown UUID.
implementation.limiter_identity_storage: Named authentication and invitation limiters use keyed HMAC fingerprints; canonical variants share a bucket and plaintext email is not retained in limiter keys.
implementation.malformed_email_contract: Non-scalar array-shaped email input is rejected by validation without an unhandled canonicalization exception.
implementation.demo_seed_transaction_boundary: All demo identity, institution, and membership writes are atomic; mid-seed failure rolls back every fixture write.
implementation.demo_seed_collision_boundary: Existing non-demo identities and non-fixture institutions are never overwritten; idempotent reuse requires the expected disposable-demo membership marker.
implementation.release_activation_evidence: Production delivery and rollback snapshot validation require activation actor, timestamp, reason, and a matching append-only active transition event.
implementation.production_rollback_policy: Disabled until B17 rehearsal; snapshot activation/release/checksum/seven-gate evidence is validated before any restore mutation.
implementation.production_artifact_boundary: APP_KEY must be supported by APP_CIPHER; referenced Vite assets must exist inside public/build; Composer dev packages, node_modules, and public/hot must be absent.
implementation.multi_institution_progress_boundary: Owner approved institution-attributed staff visibility and combined learner history; B06 must add provenance for new rows and keep legacy rows explicitly unattributed.
implementation.account_archival_boundary: A reversible disabled-account state is installed and verified across authentication, password reset, invitations, sessions, audit, and readiness. No authoritative account is disabled.
